{{Quote|I created me! They junked me after a century of loyal mechanical service. So I repaired myself.|The Proto Droid Proto One|<ref name="A Race to the Finish" />}}
A '''Proto Droid''' was a specific kind of self-constructed [[Monster droid/Legends|junk droid]].<ref name="The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" /><ref name="storybook">[[A Race to the Finish (book)|''A Race to the Finish'' picture book]]</ref> The rickety [[Proto One]], who rebuilt his broken self with diverse replacement parts and resembled a strange mixture of many different droid types,<ref name="Second Edition">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> was a Proto Droid.<ref name="storybook" />
